name: ActiveCampaign API Sentry Context
description: Add context to Sentry when creating or updating resources.
project_description: A submodule of activecampaign_api that enriches Sentry (Raven) error reports with the payload of ActiveCampaign create/update resource calls. It implements the parent module's create/update alter hooks and calls Sentry's configureScope() to attach the request data and endpoint URL as a named context, so that when an API call later fails the report shows exactly what was being sent. Requires both activecampaign_api and the raven module.
